Each new agent identity must be confirmed by a quorum of existing identities whose trust graph positions sit on distinct vertex-disjoint paths from a shared seed island, so duplicates collapse onto overlapping paths and get flagged. To pass, an attacker must grow a separate glacier of established, path-diverse identities per fake account, paying full onboarding and maintenance costs each time rather than reusing one cluster.
